text:
Lina M: FYI — big prospect asked for a "pilot-plus" bundle: reserved throughput, priority routing, admin on-prem connector for compliance tests, and an upfront credit pool with rollover. wants pilot contract in 2 weeks.

Tom S: got it. pricing note: credits that rollover + priority routing are effectively a discount. need to model elastic vs reserved economics. i'll sketch impact if they use 40% burst above committed.

Grace H: docs concern: we must be explicit about what "priority routing" actually guarantees (latency SLO vs queue priority). otherwise support will get flooded with "why am I slow?" tickets. i'll draft an entitlements grid.

Dylan P: ops items: we need per-customer priority queue metrics, and a throttling plan if the credit pool drains. can we expose a billing hook so AE sees remaining credits?

Marta L: AE ask: customer wants the ability to convert pilot to Dedicated quickly if pilot hits >X sustained QPS. need an upgrade path defined in the contract and in infra.

legal-bot: auto: initial legal guidance 4: no open-ended rollovers without a cap; indemnity and SOC review required for on-prem connector. i'll work with Lina on proposed exhibit language.

Tom S: for modeling give me: committed RPS, expected peak multiplier, average tokens per request. Lina, can AE get those from the prospect?

Lina M: yes — i'll ask. they estimated 300 RPS committed, peaks to 1k for short windows, avg 600 tokens/request.

Dylan P: plan proposal: 
1) feature-flag "pilot_plus_priority" toggled per-customer
2) credit_pool meter with webhook to billing service
3) auto-throttle to committed rate when credits < 10%
4) ops alert for sustained >1.5x committed for >20m

Grace H: docs will include a short FAQ: what rollover means, how credits are consumed, and upgrade steps to Dedicated. also example table: 

```
Committed | Monthly Credits | Rollover | Priority
300 RPS   | 1M tokens       | up to 30%| bronze
500 RPS   | 1.8M tokens     | up to 20%| silver
```

Marta L: contract gating: pilot on-prem connector requires SOC attestation and scheduled window for tests. no permanent data-plane installation during pilot.

Tom S: for pricing scenarios i'll run three sims (low/typical/high) and include per-token unit cost + implied discount from rollover. target to share by EOD tomorrow.

Lina M: next steps: Lina (confirm workload numbers), Tom (pricing sims), Marta + Legal (pilot upgrade + exhibit), Dylan (feature flag + billing webhook), Grace (entitlements doc + FAQ). we'll reconvene Thursday 11am for go/no-go.

ops-bot: feature-flag created: "pilot_plus_priority" owner=product, env=staging

Lina M: thanks everyone — please drop updates in this thread. I'll push a draft term sheet after legal posts their exhibit. :wave:
